title: Do not discard command failures unconditionally
why: Appending || true or || : hides every failure mode and can let later commands operate on missing or partial output.
suggestion: Handle expected status codes explicitly, log the tolerated failure, or terminate when the command is required.
limitations: Only unconditional || true and || : forms are reported.
At most one representative advisory is reported per file.
The rule cannot infer whether a comment or external policy documents an intentional best-effort command.
